_about: Price-integrity gate (backtester/integrity.py, run by data.load on every price file). 'overrides' are manual decisions the gate applies: action 'split' (record a split of 'ratio' new shares per old share on that day and back-adjust the earlier prices), 'rescale' (back-adjust by 1/'ratio' without recording a split: the earlier prices were on a wrong basis, no split happened) 'ignore' (leave the day alone), 'break' (a security break: a new security spliced into the series from that day, e.g. new shares listed under the old symbol after a bankruptcy; positions held into it are closed at the old security's last close and rules read each security's bars separately, see integrity.find_breaks) or 'no_break' (a jump find_breaks would read as a break that is not one). 'inferred' is written by scripts/fetch_data.py after each data run: every repair the gate made, with its evidence.

2020-11-20.why: Oasis Petroleum's Chapter 11 (plan effective 2020-11-19): the old common shares were cancelled (their holders got a small share of the new equity and warrants) and the new shares listed on Nasdaq on 2020-11-20 under the same symbol (OAS, now CHRD); the source splices the old shares' $0.12 onto the new shares' $31.00
